kdc_db_dir.description: Directory where the KDC database and related files are stored.

kdc_db_mode.description: Base name for the lock file (e.g., 'kdc' → /path/kdc.lock).

kdc_realm.description: Default realm for the KDC instance.

kdc_enable_audit.description: Enable audit logging (records access to sensitive resources).

kdc_enable_http.description: Enable HTTP interface for kadmin (remote administration over HTTPS).

kdc_enable_hprop.description: Enable hprop (replication) client functionality in KDC.

kdc_enable_hpropd.description: Enable hpropd (replication daemon) to accept incoming propagation requests.

kdc_enable_kadmin.description: Enable kadmin service (remote administration via kadmin protocol).

kdc_enable_kadmin_local.description: Enable kadmin.local (local-only administration, e.g., via kerberosd or scripts).

kdc_acl_file.description: Path to the ACL file defining access permissions for kadmin/kadmin.local.

kdc_keytab_file.description: Path to the KDC's keytab file containing its service keys.

kdc_log_file.description: Path to the main KDC log file.

kdc_max_life.description: Default maximum lifetime (in seconds) for tickets (default: 24h).

kdc_max_renewable_life.description: Default maximum renewable lifetime (in seconds) for tickets (default: 7d).

kdc_default_flags.description: Default ticket flags to set for new principals (e.g., 'pre-auth', 'forwardable').

kdc_listen.description: List of network interfaces/addresses and optional ports/protocols to bind to for KDC traffic.

interface.description: Network interface name (e.g., eth0); if empty, use 'address' instead.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required only if SSL/TLS used on this listener).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required only if SSL/TLS used on this listener).

kdc_realm_configs.description: Per-realm override configurations (if multiple realms or non-default settings needed).

database.description: Per-realm database path; defaults to kdc.database if omitted.

keytab.description: Per-realm keytab path; defaults to kdc.keytab if omitted.

max_life.description: Per-realm ticket max lifetime (seconds); overrides global kdc.max_life.

max_renewable_life.description: Per-realm renewable lifetime (seconds); overrides global kdc.max_renewable_life.

default_flags.description: Per-realm default ticket flags; overrides kdc.default_flags.

preauth_types.description: Per-realm supported pre-auth types; overrides kdc.preauth_types.

acl_file.description: Per-realm ACL file path; overrides kdc.acl_file if present.

log_file.description: Per-realm log file path; overrides kdc.log_file if present.

enabled.description: Enable hpropd to accept incoming replication requests.

listen_address.description: Address hpropd binds to (default localhost for security).

acl_file.description: ACL file for hpropd access control.

kdc_http.description: HTTP interface for kadmin (remote admin via HTTP/S).

enabled.description: Enable HTTP kadmin server (requires SSL for production).

listen_address.description: Address to bind HTTP kadmin to (default localhost).

enabled.description: Enable kadmin daemon (remote admin via kadmin protocol).

acl_file.description: ACL file for kadmin access control.

enabled.description: Enable kadmin.local (e.g., used by Heimdal tools like kadmin -l).

kdc_hprop.description: Hprop (replication) client settings — used to push DB changes to other KDCs.

enabled.description: Enable hprop client to send DB updates to replica KDCs.

source.description: Source database file (typically the primary KDC DB).

destinations.description: List of replica KDC hostnames/IPs to push changes to.
